text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and request timeouts detected for service=redwood-inference-gateway in prod-us-west-2. p95 latency jumped to ~2.4s, p99 ~7.8s, 5xx rate ~12% in last 5m. Triggering pager and incident channel.

micah (oncall): I'm on it. Paging P0 runbook now. Any recent deploys?

deploy-bot: Deploy completed: canary/2026-03-14-09:12 -> rollout started at 1742344800, 25% traffic shifted.

esme (eng-runtime): yep that rollout. Noted increased tail latencies matching the rollout window. Seeing increased backend timeouts to model-serving pods.

micah (oncall): Can someone grab logs from the gateway and model pods? I'll throttle canary to 0% if needed.

raj (sre): I'm pulling request traces. Early sign: KV cache misses spiked and connection churn to the model backend increased. P95 tokens/sec per worker dropped.

katie (prod-ops): Customer-facing metrics: ~8 customers saw degraded responses, support tickets inbound. Putting a banner draft for status page.

micah (oncall): Ok step 1: rollback canary to previous revision for immediate mitigation. Can someone initiate?

esme (eng-runtime): Rolling back canary now. Command:

```bash
kubectl set image deployment/inference-gateway inference-gateway=registry/redwood/inference-gateway:stable-2026-03-14-08 -n prod-us-west-2
```

micah (oncall): Confirm when traffic is shifted and error rates drop.

deploy-bot: Rollback triggered at 1742345220. Scaling to stable revision.

raj (sre): Observability: error rate starting to fall. p95 from 2.4s -> 380ms within 2m. p99 still trending down. 5xx down to ~3.5%.

katie (prod-ops): Status page: "Degraded: High latency for inference requests in US-WEST-2. Mitigation in progress (rollback)." Posting now.

micah (oncall): Good. I'm going to run a quick canary replay against stable to confirm. If stable looks good, keep rollback and start postmortem.

esme (eng-runtime): Replays: stable passes local load tests at expected latency. The problematic image seems to have introduced a cache eviction path under certain seq-length distributions. I have a reproducer.

raj (sre): Collected heap and connection metrics from model pods during spike; will attach traces to the incident ticket. Preliminary hypothesis: a new batching optimization introduced an unsafe edge-case for KV cache TTL leading to cold-cache storms.

micah (oncall): Customer impact summary for now: transient increased latency and 5xxs for ~15 minutes, affecting a subset of requests routed to canary. We rolled back canary at +7m after spike detection. Support notified.

katie (prod-ops): I've messaged the top affected accounts with a heads-up and ETA for root-cause follow-up.

esme (eng-runtime): Will open an internal PR to revert the batching change and add targeted unit + integration tests. Also adding a telemetry guard for cache miss rate thresholds to auto-suppress dangerous rollouts.

micah (oncall): Handoff: I'm paging the next oncall (raj) at 1742346900 for continuing RCA and postmortem write-up. Leaving the channel; monitoring until fully stable. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
